svt_mipi_dsi_read_cmd_device_response_sequence Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Default sequence class for generating default sequence. This class is extended from svt_mipi_dsi_device_base_sequence class for applying configuration on the generated sequence. It will receives packet from the Device driver and generates response data and passed it to the Device driver to sendresponse transaction. If internal memory is enable then, packet fields will be updated from the device driver. This class should be registered into the testcases to generates response sequence.

Member Constraint Documentation

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_read_cmd_device_response_sequence::reasonable_gen_long_read_resp_word_count

Following constraint is to control the data word count of the Response Packet incase the Set Max Return Packet Size is not set by Host and Response Return Packet Size is not set by the Device Side.
constraint reasonable_gen_long_read_resp_word_count {
    gen_long_read_resp_word_count inside {[ 1: 100]};
